adds.name: Shawnee State Park - Ohio River Campground
adds.waterfront_evidence: Ohio OSIP leaf-off imagery (0.13 m/px; Esri is stale) with ODNR's per-site map and ReserveOhio site photos: pads ~13-17 m over open grass from the 'Paddling Loop' lagoon at 38.6825,-83.1030 (sites 50-52; photo of #52 shows water just past the pad), ~12-25 m from a pond at 38.6830,-83.1058 (sites 60-65), ~30 m from a fountain pond at 38.6845,-83.1058 (sites 8-11; photo of #10). Thin line in the imagery is construction silt fence, gone in the photos; no road or bluff between. Man-made, about 3 ha, so pond, not lake. Ohio River is not the water here: ~380 m from the nearest pad, ~620 m from centre, behind shore forest. Only some sites.
adds.inclusion_evidence: ODNR page ('80 full hook-up sites with paved pads', own Camp Store/Check-in) and per-site map + ReserveOhio facility 845 (every unit read 2026-10-31: 78 sold online, lengths 47-130 ft, nightly use) -> real drive-in RV campground, fits 23 ft. Own place: 8.2 km straight, 11.1 km by road from Turkey Creek (entry 1026); entrance and a separate exit on US 52, where Turkey Creek is off SR 125.
adds.note: The park's riverside campground, off US 52 beside the marina on open former golf-course ground, about 8 km from Turkey Creek. Ponds and the man-made Paddling Loop lie right beside some sites; the Ohio River itself is a few hundred metres off behind shore forest. --Claude

sites.note: ODNR: 80 full hook-up sites, 5 ADA. ReserveOhio sells 78 online (#32 and #60 are not offered; no reason given). Lengths 47-130 ft; of the 78, 20 pull-through and 58 back-in. Paved; shade varies by site.

hookups.note: Every site lists 30/50 amp, water and sewer.

season.note: ODNR states no season. ReserveOhio sold nights in each month read, November 2026 to April 2027. In winter only sites 1-20 and 61-80 are sold; 21-60 were blocked on January 20, 2027.

booking.note: Facility 845 on ReserveOhio. The longest stay reads two ways: 7 nights on each site's details, 14 in the facility's restrictions, so ask before booking over a week.

fees.note: ReserveOhio: $65 from April 1 ($55 off-peak, November 1 to March 31), the same on a Saturday. Plus tax and a $6.50 reservation fee.
